scope: Small deterministic two-frame verification; no new scenes, training, interval probe, publication, or title change
independence: New implementation: Cartesian component Jacobian and Hessian; independent cone minimizer checked by SLSQP; original numerical modules are not imported

cases.changed_angle_observations: Saved next-frame noise residual retained exactly; rotate the clean next-frame polarization by twice the angle change
cases.dependence: Same 60 stored conditions reused across methods, tolerances and angle changes; same-seed noise reused across source conditions; no independent-scene or population-rate interpretation

main_precision: float64 objective, derivatives and optimizer; evaluation input dtypes logged
previous_frame: Each solver/tolerance computes its own previous raw estimate from fixed initial_head; the same method/tolerance continues at the next frame, including unsuccessful previous fits, which are flagged

precision_control.solver: PyTorch LBFGS, strong_wolfe, CPU, one thread
precision_control.success_definition: No native success flag: operational gradient acceptance iff finite and independently recomputed native-dtype head gradient infinity norm <= gtol
precision_control.oracle: Evaluate final represented coordinates using float64 saved observations and compare to cone optimum; also retain native-oracle gradient and evaluation dtypes
precision_control.SciPy_promotion_probe: One preselected source row (index 0), BFGS initialized float32; record all incoming x and returned gradient/result dtypes; do not label it full float32

restart.candidate: Lowest float64 loss among both offsets and current point, deterministic order; same solver/options; one restart only; include failures

physical_certificate: For M=inv(W), n=(-1,e), sigma=I*(1-phi), lambda=max(0,-(n'Mg+sigma)/(n'Mn)), B=0.5*(g+lambda*n)'M*(g+lambda*n)+lambda*sigma. Accept iff finite, feasible and B<=1e-6. Use full gradient bound when r=0. Conservative rejection is reported separately.
recovered_certificate: Within radius threshold, recover tangential gradient from head gradient and radial gradient from scalar head curvature corrected by known h_rr=0.5; compare gradient and B to direct values. No physical-gradient withholding is assumed.
false_success: Native solver success (or explicit operational acceptance for PyTorch) AND float64 cone objective gap > gap_threshold
costs: Count optimizer function/gradient/Hessian calls separately from diagnostic and trial evaluations; record all warnings, statuses, exceptions, nonfinite calls, previous failures and post-restart failures. Curvature uses one full 3x3 Hessian in this implementation. Counts, not general speed claims.
theory_review: Levin-Kileel-Boumal Thm 2.4, Thm 3.23, Lem 3.24, Prop 3.26, Sec 6(b)
Lee et al. 2016 assumptions and Thm 4
Bounded current literature search for warm-start, invariant-set and approximate-stopping claims

support_required: False success beyond a single solver or nominal low precision
Concrete statement-level distinction from prior theory
Diagnostic value over blind restarting, supported by rejection precision/coverage and saved additional solver evaluations
stop_if: Effect limited to one solver, rounding or an extreme isolated setting
No specific diagnostic value beyond generic restart
Newness remains only a known chain-rule specialization and illustrative failure
decision.if_supported: Only then undertake proof, principal figures and scientific manuscript revision
decision.if_not_supported: Retain frozen manuscript and produce evidence/decision report without promoting candidate to main contribution
